content: .{@-ज्ञ@} {%a.%} .²1 one who appreciates the flavour or excellence of, one who knows the taste of; सांसारिकेषु च सुखेषु वयं रसज्ञाः <ls>U. 2. 22</ls>. .²2 capable of discerning the beauty of things. . ({@-ज्ञः@}) .²1 a man of taste or feeling, a critic, an appreciative person, a poet. .²2 an alchemist. .²3 a physician, or one who prepares mercurial or other chemical compounds. . ({@-ज्ञा@}) the tongue; साखि मा जल्प तवायसी रसज्ञा <ls>Bv. 2. 59</ls>; .({@रसज्ञता, त्वम्@} means .²1 poetical skill. .²2 alchemy. .²3 knowledge of flavours. .²4 discrimination.).
